keycloak.js
===========

Unmodified copy of keycloak-js, version 24.0.2.

Source:  Seschat/Client/node_modules/keycloak-js/dist/keycloak.js
Project: https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak
License: Apache License 2.0 (Copyright 2016 Red Hat, Inc. and/or its affiliates)

The full license header is still at the top of the file and was not removed.
License text: http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Why this file and not keycloak.mjs
----------------------------------
The package ships three builds:

  keycloak.mjs      ES module. Imports `js-sha256` and `jwt-decode` by bare
                    package name, which a browser cannot resolve without a
                    bundler or an import map. NOT usable for this project.

  keycloak.js       UMD bundle with both dependencies inlined. Loads via
                    <script src> and sets window.Keycloak. This is the file
                    used here.

  keycloak.min.js   The same, only unreadable. Pointless for a teaching
                    project whose whole purpose is to look inside.

Why the file is vendored
------------------------
The project is meant to run without `npm install`. Apache 2.0 permits
redistribution as long as the license notice is preserved, which it is.
